title: Corrected SSF capacity conventions
extraction_rule: Select equal-notional median/p10/minimum. Include liquidity-proportional median solely as a labelled non-gate diagnostic.

study_context.instrument: near-month single-stock futures; next-session open to same non-expiry-session settle
study_context.benchmark: equal-weight valid PIT-F&O SSF long return on the same entry session
study_context.costs: historically dated statutory stack; frozen ADV-only impact sweep 0.5×,1×,2×; current statutory counterfactual dated 2026-07-30
study_context.inference: recorded two-way clustering by date and symbol

caveats: Execution-QA v1.0.1 supersedes the earlier fill and capacity figures.
Frozen impact curve depends on ADV rather than direct order size.
Gross significance does not override fillability, interaction, capacity, regime or net-return failures.
The current statutory-only row is a dated counterfactual, not a present-day cost quotation.
Equal-notional event-count × minimum-name capacity is binding; the ADV-sum diagnostic is not capacity for this equal-event book.
